proposal.description: Over-temperature (OT) and over-current (OC) are confused in the bit map: OTP is placed in bit 0 and OVERCURRENT in bit 2
proposal.reason: An OTP during S_SS or S_RUN sets fault_reg bit 0 instead of bit 2, and an overcurrent window trip sets bit 2 instead of bit 0. Firmware then decodes an overheated board as an overcurrent, and the reverse.

proposal.description: The two lock-type causes are confused in the bit map: the CPLD latch trip (LATCH_ASSERT) is placed in bit 1 and under-voltage lockout (UVLO) in bit 3
proposal.reason: A latch_assert trip while the converter runs sets fault_reg bit 1 instead of bit 3, and a UVLO sets bit 3 instead of bit 1. Firmware reports an OCP/SCP latch trip as a brown-out, and the reverse.

proposal.description: A host read acknowledges only the highest-priority recorded cause and leaves the lower-priority causes in the record, instead of clearing the whole record
proposal.reason: Suppose a record holds two causes, for example OTP and OVERCURRENT, and the host reads it after the converter has stopped. fault_reg still shows OVERCURRENT after the read, although it should be empty. fault_time is cleared, so the remaining record has no start time.

proposal.description: UVLO opens an episode only in S_RUN: a Vin dip during soft start is treated as inrush sag and does not stamp fault_time, although the accumulator still records it
proposal.reason: Suppose UVLO is the first cause, and it asserts during S_SS. fault_reg gets the UVLO bit, but fault_time stays zero instead of taking timestamp_ms. Later causes do not stamp it either, because the record is no longer empty.
